comment: Original Red Panda Particle 2-inspired granular delay approximation. Eight modes cover random, density, LFO, random-pitch, reverse, detune, density-pitch, and LFO-pitch behavior. This is not a firmware clone; stereo processing, tap tempo, MIDI sync, freeze footswitch, and the original feedback options are not modeled.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: Selects one of the five granular-delay or three pitch modes.

params.name: Density
params.comment: Grain overlap and texture modulation amount.

params.name: Delay
params.comment: Base grain delay, up to approximately 2.4 seconds.

params.name: Feedback
params.comment: Amount of granular output recirculated into the delay buffer; shown as Feed on the pedal.
